subtitle.en: A Reluctant Prophet — God's Mercy on a Pagan City
subtitle.hans: 不情愿的先知——神怜悯外邦城市
subtitle.hant: 不情願的先知——神憐憫外邦城市

summary.en: Jonah is the prophet who fled, was swallowed by a great fish, finally preached to Nineveh — and then sulked when the city repented and was spared. The book ends with God's question: should I not pity this great city? A challenge to every reader's narrowness of love.
summary.hans: 约拿是逃避使命的先知，被大鱼吞了，最终向尼尼微传道——见城悔改、神免其灾，他反而生气。全书以神的问题作结：我岂不应怜悯这大城吗？这是对每个读者「狭窄之爱」的挑战。
summary.hant: 約拿是逃避使命的先知，被大魚吞了，最終向尼尼微傳道——見城悔改、神免其災，他反而生氣。全書以神的問題作結：我豈不應憐憫這大城嗎？這是對每個讀者「狹窄之愛」的挑戰。

author.en: Anonymous; about Jonah son of Amittai
author.hans: 作者不详；记述亚米太的儿子约拿
author.hant: 作者不詳；記述亞米太的兒子約拿

audience.en: Israelites tempted to think God's mercy stops at their borders
audience.hans: 以为神的怜悯只到本国边境的以色列民
audience.hant: 以為神的憐憫只到本國邊境的以色列民

keyPassageDesc.en: The book's final, unanswered question — 'Should I not pity Nineveh?' — leaves the prophet (and the reader) face to face with the breadth of God's compassion.
keyPassageDesc.hans: 全书最后未得答复的问题——「我岂能不爱惜尼尼微吗？」——使先知（与读者）直面神宽广的怜悯。
keyPassageDesc.hant: 全書最後未得答覆的問題——「我豈能不愛惜尼尼微嗎？」——使先知（與讀者）直面神寬廣的憐憫。

32001001.contextHans: 约拿不是逃避使命，而是逃避神的怜悯——他不愿尼尼微悔改。圣经中最诚实的先知。
32001001.contextHant: 約拿不是逃避使命，而是逃避神的憐憫——他不願尼尼微悔改。聖經中最誠實的先知。
32001001.contextEn: Jonah doesn't flee the mission — he flees God's mercy. He doesn't want Nineveh to repent. Perhaps the Bible's most honest prophet.

32001017.contextHans: 在大鱼腹中——耶稣称这为他复活的预表（太12:40）。
32001017.contextHant: 在大魚腹中——耶穌稱這為他復活的預表（太12:40）。
32001017.titleEn: In the Belly of the Fish
32001017.contextEn: In the belly of the fish — Jesus calls this a foreshadow of his own resurrection (Matt 12:40).

32002001.contextHans: 约拿的祷告——在最深的地方仍能呼求神。
32002001.contextHant: 約拿的禱告——在最深的地方仍能呼求神。
32002001.contextEn: Jonah's prayer — even from the depths, you can call on God.

32003001.contextHans: 尼尼微全城悔改——耶稣称约拿的事工为他复活的预表（太12:40）。
32003001.contextHant: 尼尼微全城悔改——耶穌稱約拿的事工為他復活的預表（太12:40）。
32003001.contextEn: Nineveh repents — pagan Assyrians outdo God's own people in turning from sin. Jesus cites Jonah as a sign of his own resurrection (Matt 12:40).

32004001.contextHans: 约拿的怒气——他不愿尼尼微悔改。神温柔地教导他怜悯。
32004001.contextHant: 約拿的怒氣——他不願尼尼微悔改。神溫柔地教導他憐憫。
32004001.contextEn: Jonah's anger — he didn't want Nineveh repented. God patiently teaches him compassion.

events.sumEn: Yahweh appoints a great fish to swallow Jonah, who remains inside three days and nights.

events.sumEn: Jonah warns Nineveh; its people and king repent, and Yahweh relents from disaster.

events.sumEn: Jonah resents Nineveh's mercy; Yahweh uses a plant to teach compassion.
